sloka: नीलाञ्जनचयाकारास्ते तु तं प्रत्यबोधयन् ।अभिघ्नन्तो नदन्तश्च नैव संविविदे तु सः ।। ६.६०.४४ ।।।।
transliteration: nīlāñjanacayākārāste tu taṁ pratyabodhayan ।abhighnanto nadantaśca naiva saṁvivide tu saḥ ।। 6.60.44 ।।।।

translations.english: They urged horses, elephants, camels, and donkeys to pounce on him, whipping with staff, whips, and goads.
